title: Computation of Post-9/11 Entitlement Credited on an Election
content:
**Award computation — Post-9/11 entitlement credited when a student of Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) elects the Post-9/11 GI Bill in place of Chapter 30 or Chapter 1606.**

**Unit.** The entitlement credited is measured in days of a 30-day month.

**Amount credited.** The Post-9/11 entitlement credited on an election is the full grant of 36 months of 30 days — the months granted on a full Certificate of Eligibility multiplied by the days of a month — never more than that full grant, and rounded half up to a whole day once, at the end.

| Element | Figure |
|---|---|
| Months in the full grant | 36 |
| Days in a month | 30 |
| Full grant | 36 multiplied by 30: 1080 days |
| Ceiling on the days credited | 1080 days |
| Rounding | Half up to a whole day, once, at the end |

**Worked figure.** A student elects the Post-9/11 GI Bill in place of Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30): the entitlement credited is 1080 days. A figure worked out above 1080 days, for example 1104 days, is credited as 1080; a figure of 1000.5 days is rounded half up to 1001.
